dictionary.title: Privacy
dictionary.description: Decide where your data may go. {assistant} recognises when a request contains personal or sensitive data and sends it only to the models you allowed.
dictionary.engine_hint: The model running on this computer, used for data that must not leave it.
dictionary.engine_none_hint: Without a local model, protected profiles hold sensitive requests back instead of sending them online.
dictionary.engine_local_hint: Ready: personal and sensitive requests can stay here.
dictionary.engine_home_hint: The Ollama engine is on another computer of the home network: it does not count as local for sensitive data.
dictionary.engine_remote_hint: The Ollama engine is outside the home network: for privacy it is treated as an online service.
dictionary.default_hint: Applies to anyone without their own rule. With several people present the most protective rule applies.
dictionary.people_hint: Each person can have a different rule. It applies to their requests and to data about them.
dictionary.people_empty: No people registered yet. Add them from the People app.
dictionary.profile_auto_hint: Balanced when there is a local model on this computer, otherwise Open.
dictionary.profile_inherit: Same as the rule for everyone
dictionary.profile_max_hint: Personal and sensitive data only on the local model. Everything else anywhere.
dictionary.profile_balanced_hint: Sensitive data only on the local model, personal data also on home servers, everything else anywhere.
dictionary.profile_open_hint: Everything goes to the chosen provider, including online services and remote Ollama.
dictionary.profile_custom_hint: Choose where personal and sensitive data may go.
dictionary.sensitive_looser: Sensitive data cannot have a more open rule than personal data.
dictionary.audit_hint: Last {days} days. Only requests are counted, never their content.
